title: Materials
question: Which materials are used in the brine loop?

options.label: Titanium HEX plates, no copper alloys in contact with brine
Stainless-steel HEX plates
options.notes: fails the §10.1 materials check for saline brine

choice_label: Titanium HEX plates, no copper alloys in contact with brine

criterion.text: materials check of spec §10.1 for saline brine (brine)

rationale: The choice is based on the brine material check among guard-passed options in economics, as specified in the design basis. titanium-plates-no-cu is the only option that satisfies the saline brine requirements of spec §10.1. stainless-plates was rejected because it failed the same material check.
